column1: # Example: Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Rv proteins whose cysteine S-sulfenylation (SOH) changed significantly under oxidative stress (50 microM H2O2) and were also changed in the total cysteine group.

# Source: Lu Y, Chen H, Wang P, et al. (2023) Identification and Quantification of S-Sulfenylation Proteome of Mycobacterium tuberculosis under Oxidative Stress. Microbiol Spectr 11(2):e0338622. https://doi.org/10.1128/spectrum.03386-22

# Table S3 (spectrum.03386-22-s0004.xlsx), "Overlapped significantly modified proteins of total cysteine and SOH under H2O2 pressure". Cutoff: the paper's own filter of P < 0.05 within each group, giving 68 proteins significant in both; all 68 listed rows are kept. Licensed CC BY 4.0; values as published.

# Columns: protein = gene symbol in the LIVIA Atlas index, mapped from the table's accession or Rv number (unmapped rows keep the table's own first name); uniprot = index accession; name_in_table / accession_in_table as given; SOH_sites = SOH modification site count; SOH_log2_ratio and SOH_p_value = the table's SOH abundance ratio (log2) and P value, treated (R) over control (C).
